timing_scope.runtime_processing_ms: Unsharp/Wiener: in-process CPU (single process, cv2/numpy threads as configured); NAFNet: GPU t_total_ms from the NAFNet manifest (uint8 in memory -> uint8 out, excludes model load, warm-up and PNG I/O). Not comparable across devices.
timing_scope.runtime_detect_ms: detector.detect() on the detection image (stage rows); detectAndCompute for CLEAN
timing_scope.runtime_detect_and_compute_ms: detectAndCompute on the same image (BB/RR/CLEAN; base-comparable)
timing_scope.runtime_ms: processing + detect + describe + match + homography (reference detection excluded, as in base)
